name: test_NAF_2_2_0_login_with_wrong_email
description:
Test Case: NAF-15
    As a user, I want to log in with my email and password
    Scenario: Login Unsuccessful due to Non-existent Email
    
    Steps:
    1. Open the app
    2. Click on "Log in" button
    3. Click on "Sign in with your email" button
    4. Enter non-existent email: test@example.com
    5. Enter password: testpassword
    6. Click "Log in" button    
    7. Verify error message appears
    
    Expected Result: Error message "There is no account associated with this email. Please sign up." should be displayed

    def test_NAF_2_2_0_login_with_wrong_email(self, setup_and_teardown):
        logger.info("Starting login with wrong email test")
    
        driver = setup_and_teardown
        try:
            # login with wrong email and correct password
            login_page = LoginPage(driver)
            login_page.login(Config.TEST_EMAIL_WRONG, Config.TEST_PASSWORD)
    
            login_page.error_message_no_account_associated()
            logger.info("Login with wrong email test completed")
    
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Login with wrong email test failed as expected: {str(e)}")
